purpose: Evidence-preserving index of research, course reports, datasets, technical knowledge articles, source code, and historical book texts discovered in selected public repositories owned by andrehacker.
method: GitHub recursive Git tree metadata; each listed artifact records its Git blob SHA and byte size. No files were downloaded into BODY OF SECRETS by this inventory operation.
caveats: This is a metadata inventory of the selected relevant file classes, not a claim that every byte or historical revision in the account has been examined.
Git blob SHA identifies the exact Git object; it is not a separately computed SHA-256 digest of the decoded file bytes.
Repository visibility does not grant a license. Rights are assigned per source item where exact source evidence was verified; otherwise UNKNOWN_HOLD or RESTRICTED.

The `andrehacker/mapred` Britannica file is byte-for-byte the same Git blob as `ljrseals-dev/5-Senses` data/sample_corpus/encyclopedia/encyclopaedia-britannica-11th-vol4-part3.txt (blob SHA eeaedce9f1b3d784f23d383786714daf68974931).
MAT files are legacy numerical artifacts / fitted factor matrices / intermediate outputs, not automatically reusable pretrained neural-network weights.
PDF reports in fu-pattern-rec are coursework / technical reports, not automatically peer-reviewed publications.
